title: Minimum booking hours
confirmed_claims: TempGuru bills a minimum of 4 hours per worker per shift, with no exceptions.
disclaimer: Operational policy summary, not a contract. A coordinator confirms event-specific terms on the binding quote and order documentation.

title: Cancellation and rescheduling
confirmed_claims: Cancelling without a fee requires at least 48 hours' notice before the scheduled shift. With less notice, the 4-hour minimum is billed for each booked worker and shift.
Rescheduling also requires at least 48 hours' notice; with less notice, the 4-hour minimum applies.
disclaimer: Operational policy summary, not a contract. A coordinator confirms event-specific terms on the binding quote and order documentation.

title: Replacement and backfill
confirmed_claims: TempGuru aims to replace a no-show within 2 hours. This is a target, not a guarantee. Replacements follow applicable state and local wage-and-hour, reporting-time, standby, and minimum-shift rules.
disclaimer: Operational policy summary, not a contract. A coordinator confirms event-specific terms on the binding quote and order documentation.

title: COI and additional insured
confirmed_claims: Certificates of insurance are standard practice when a venue requires them.
TempGuru is responsible for COIs naming the venue as additional insured before staff can work.
TempGuru needs at least one week's notice before load-in to issue a COI or additional-insured endorsement; more notice is preferred.
disclaimer: Operational policy summary, not a contract. A coordinator confirms event-specific terms on the binding quote and order documentation.

title: Payment and invoicing
confirmed_claims: Clients work through one TempGuru vendor relationship and one contract with TempGuru; invoices are consolidated as one invoice per city per week.
No payment is required until the buyer approves the quote.
A deposit is required after the buyer approves the quote. It is a percentage of the quote total, set on each quote; there is no standard percentage.
Invoices are due net 30.
Orders scheduled less than 72 hours before the event carry a $150 rush fee per order.
There is no subscription; billing is per event.

Published hourly bill rates include worker pay, employer payroll taxes, workers' compensation, general liability, TempGuru coordination, and the partner agency's markup. Overtime, holiday premiums, rush-order charges, parking, travel, uniforms, client-required background checks, minimum-shift charges, gratuities, and cancellation fees can be separate when applicable; the quote identifies the applicable hourly rates and approved event-specific charges before confirmation.
disclaimer: Operational policy summary, not a contract. A coordinator confirms event-specific terms on the binding quote and order documentation.

title: Background checks
confirmed_claims: Background checks are available when the event or venue requires them.
The client sets the scope: a general US background check, or screening for the specific criteria the client requires.
Cost depends on the checks the client requests.
TempGuru needs at least 2 weeks' lead time for background checks.
disclaimer: Operational policy summary, not a contract. A coordinator confirms event-specific terms on the binding quote and order documentation.

title: Order confirmation SLA
confirmed_claims: Once scope and rates are approved, TempGuru returns an availability response within 24-48 hours. That response is not a guaranteed completed roster; same-week and emergency requests are best effort and depend on local capacity.
disclaimer: Operational policy summary, not a contract. A coordinator confirms event-specific terms on the binding quote and order documentation.

title: Quote response SLA
confirmed_claims: After the buyer submits the form, TempGuru reviews the scope and rates and replies with next steps. The 24-48 hour window is an availability response after scope and rates are approved, not a completed roster. A written quote is binding only once TempGuru issues it, and no payment is due until the buyer approves it.
disclaimer: Operational policy summary, not a contract. A coordinator confirms event-specific terms on the binding quote and order documentation.
